annotations.title: List clients: brands, their client links and waiting posts

description: Lists the account's brands (one per client) with, for each: the social accounts connected to it, its active client links (url, expiry, how many times opened and when last), and how many of its posts wait for approval. Also says whether the plan includes client links and how many brands have no social account connected yet.
